sonnet.problem: The card says the Tychicus of Titus 3:12 is the 'faithful servant in the Lord' from Ephesians 6:21. No verse says outright that these are the same person. The phrasing 'Artemas or Tychicus, a faithful servant' also makes it unclear who is being described.
sonnet.rule: He says two names mean the same person only when a verse says so outright, and he gives that verse.
